task_definition.instruction_en: In a fixed robotic workspace, generate a rigid, physically consistent embodied robotic arm. The arm maintains high stability with no deformation and enters the frame to Place the bowl with shiny texture down, then set the small bowl with brown edge on top of the bowl with shiny texture.
task_definition.instruction_zh: 在固定的机器人工作空间中，生成刚性的、物理一致的具体机器人手臂。手臂保持高度稳定性，不变形，进入框架将闪亮质感的碗放下，然后将棕色边缘的小碗放在闪亮质感的碗上面。
